description: This file defines the main application shell for a personal notes management web app. It sets up the UI layout, including header, sidebar with search, and main content area. It also manages event bindings for creating new notes, searching, and routing to different views (welcome, create, edit).

methods.name: renderAppShell(root)
methods.description: Renders the entire application shell layout within the specified root element, sets up event bindings, and listens for route changes to dynamically load different views.
